reasoning_content:
Postgres role creation done. Next, copy the config files per the development guide:
- cp config/database.yml.example config/database.yml
- cp config/secrets.yml.example config/secrets.yml

Also, create config/secret_emails.yml containing admin@consul.dev (mentioned as required in the guide).

After that, wait for bundle install. Let's poll.

action.command: cd /workspace && cp config/database.yml.example config/database.yml && cp config/secrets.yml.example config/secrets.yml && printf 'admin@consul.dev\n' > config/secret_emails.yml && cat config/secrets.yml.example | head -40

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && cp config/database.yml.example config/database.yml && cp config/secrets.yml.example config/secrets.yml && printf 'admin@consul.dev\\n' > config/secret_emails.yml && cat config/secrets.yml.example | head -40", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Copy config examples, create secret_emails.yml"}
